summary: Pakistani organizations should prioritize patching critical vulnerabilities, particularly CVE-2026-20349 and CVE-2026-68820, which are being actively exploited and have been added to the CISA KEV catalog, affecting multiple vendors including Microsoft and Google. The presence of 71 zero-day exploits, including CVE-2026-72898 and CVE-2026-8037, poses a significant threat to local networks, and immediate attention is required to mitigate these risks. Pakistani organizations are advised to take immediate action on the five Pakistan CERT/NCCS alerts, including PKCERT-71DA9F40 and PKCERT-E48A22A6, which provide specific guidance on securing systems against threats targeting local infrastructure.
